lines: Daughter Entrati gets more than she bargained for when she enlists the Tenno to investigate a call for reinforcements aboard a Narmer Murex.
> Tenno, need your help. Check the message for details.

- Daughter: "Nora Night keeps saying Narmer isn't dead. Someone new is at the top. All she knows is a name, Pazuul. Well, guess what, Tenno? I have a lead. I detected a dot code signal broadcast from inside a Murex. It only says one thing, over and over again. "NEED REINFORCEMENTS." It's probably one of the freedom fighters Nora keeps talking about. If they made it into a Murex, they have to know about Pazuul. Come on, Tenno, say you'll help."

- Daughter: "Whoa. The inside of a Murex... organic scaffolds... node-based circulation... but on a scale I never thought possible. The Medusa network means I'm scanner blind in here. Knock it out, and I'll pinpoint the location of our messenger."

- Daughter: "When Ballas and Narmer struck the system, I was ready to do something, anything... but no, the family said we had to 'guard the Heart of Deimos'. I spent the entire war laying low in the Necralisk, listening to Nora Night talk about those brave few fighters who were out there doing exciting things. Not this time."
- Daughter: "Tenno, I think that's the central hub of the Medusa network. Without a scanner feed, you'll need to figure out how to disable it on your own."
- Daughter: "That's it! Triangulating distress beacon. There. The signal originates from the other side of the Murex. I hope they're not too frightened to talk."
- Daughter: "Don't be afraid. We're here to-"
- Kahl: "Kahl NOT Afraid. Kahl need brothers, Queens' send... Blue Girl?"
- Daughter: "A... A... A... A VAT RAT?!I can't believe I expected to find out who Pazuul is. I'm an idiot."
- Kahl: "Kahl need gun. Find Kahl gun. Kahl tell about Pazuul."
- Daughter: "Of course, of course. 'Kahl,' was it? There... Marking a weapon signature."
- Daughter: "So about Pazuul... Maybe you should just tell me everything now just in case this gets dangerous?"
- Daughter: "You got your gun, and I will guide you out of here, but first, I need you to tell me about Pazuul."
- Kahl: "Kahl find brothers. You help. Then talk."
- Daughter: ""Brothers"? "Brothers" was not what we agreed to. You said "gun"! I got you your gun! Now tell me about Pazuul!"
- Daughter: "Ugh. Perfect. The field your brother is locked in is entangled with complex restraints. Get close. I'll use your signal to target a dissipation beam."
**When Field Dissipation is at Half Progress**
- Kahl: "Brother wake up. Kahl give orders now. Come!"
- Rogg-417: "... Kahl? Where you lead, Rogg follow!"
- Daughter: "A blockage? Not even a brutish Grineer fist can punch through that... think... think.."
- Kahl: "Blue Girl stop think, Kahl see Rogg has bomb."
- Daughter: "Grineer are good at destroying things. Shocking."
- Daughter: "Vat rats are good at destroying things. Shocking."
- Daughter: "Grineer have a lot of brothers, Kahl. They're not all going to fit aboard my friend's lander."
- Daughter: "Scans show what appears to be a Grineer Dropship, but it might not even be operational."
- Kahl: "Kahl make work. First find all brothers."
- Daughter: "I don't know how, but you need to find a way across."
- Kahl: "Hellion pack. How hard could be?"
**When Field Dissipation is at Half Progress**
- Daughter: "Hold tight, Kahl. Just a little bit longer."
- Kahl: "No. Queens abandon us. Fight for brothers now."
- Kahl: "Kahl know what Veil like. Nobody deserve Veil."
- Corpus Captive: "I as ttee. I as it yout petp!" (I am free. I am in your debt.)
- Daughter: "That's everyone. Can we go now? Dropship marked."
- Daughter: "You're coming up on the Bolkor... and - of course - it's held in place by a Tether Node. I've devised an eight-step plan to evade security and gain access. Step one -"
- Kahl: "No time Blue Girl, Kahl do!!"
- Kahl: "We fight for no Queens. We fight for Brothers!"
- Daughter: "I can pilot this thing remotely but I need you to man the guns."
- Daughter: "That Tether Node still has a grip on you. Take it out."
- Daughter: "Make any more stops, and you risk everyone you already saved. And you still haven't told me about Pazuul."
- Kahl: "Blue Girl have brother? Would she leave him to die?"
- Daughter: "Ugh... You're loyal; I'll give you that. Plotting a course to the second Narmer holding facility. Hold on tight."
- Kahl: "It over. Kahl tell you about Pazuul."
- Daughter: "Not now, Kahl. I'll see if there's another way to get you and your brothers out of here."
- Daughter: "Kahl, I've called in a favor. Get to the hangar and you just might live."
- Kahl: "Tenno? Hmmm. Brothers trust Kahl, and Kahl trust you. Brothers, get in!"
- Kahl: "Save teleport for wounded. Kahl walk."
- Kahl: "No teleport! Kahl go old fashioned way."
- Kahl: "Blue Girl bring brothers aboard. Kahl check everything safe."
- Daughter: "Kahl. This is Blue Girl. Did my friend get you all set up?"
- Kahl: "Tenno is friend. Kahl tell Blue Girl about Pazuul: Body is dead worm. Head like animal."
- Kahl: "What more to know? Want kill Pazuul? Find brothers. Break veils, Kill Narmer. That what Kahl do."
- Daughter: "Fine. I'm in. We'll get more done working together. Face it, Vat Rat, you NEED me."
- Kahl: "If Narmer make Veils, Kahl and Blue Girl break them."

- Kahl: "Who help Grineer today? Not Queens. Not Vay Hek. Only Tenno and Blue Girl help brothers. Other Brothers still have Veil. So Kahl break. This camp little. But soon, it get big. You see. Kahl not afraid. And now Kahl not alone."
> Heard you're going to start hunting Archons. Now that sounds exciting!
> What if I told you that Archon Shards can be used to enhance your Warframes?
> My brother has designed a new Helminth segment for you. Build and install it, then give it a Shard to work with, and enjoy.
> (Of course, you'll need to be on speaking terms with your Helminth in order to use this, and if you don't know what I'm talking about you probably should be spending a bit more time on Deimos.)
> You know, what with Kahl doing the intel gathering on the ground, me running mission command and you all ready to take down the Archons, this team is synergizing quite deliciously.
> These items have been delivered to your inventory. ” —Daughter
- Kahl: "Blue Girl need Kahl in that spot."
- Kahl: "Kahl need to be in two places."
- Kahl: "Must send Brother to other spot."
- Kahl: "Need to split up. Kahl go there, brother go there."
